notes: path is relative to the repository root and must contain a SKILL.md.
agents lists the agent ids (see agents.json) for which the adapter has a defined transform.
depends lists skill ids that should be installed alongside this skill for it to be fully effective.
tools are optional external tools the skill can use when available; they are never required.
Installing a skill only writes instruction files. No skill content is executed.

skills.name: Frontend Architecture
skills.description: Understand and respect existing frontend structure before changing code, and keep components, state, and data access appropriately separated.

skills.name: React Best Practices
skills.description: Apply sound React component boundaries, hook usage, state placement, and rendering behavior while following the project's existing React version.

skills.name: Responsive Design
skills.description: Build layouts that work across viewport sizes, handle overflow and text wrapping, and keep mobile navigation usable.

skills.name: Accessibility (a11y)
skills.description: Use semantic HTML, keyboard support, accessible names, and correct ARIA only where native semantics are insufficient.

skills.name: Frontend Performance
skills.description: Make evidence-based frontend performance decisions about bundles, images, fonts, caching, and rendering.

skills.name: Design System
skills.description: Define and reuse color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, and state tokens instead of scattering arbitrary values.

skills.name: Frontend Form Engineering
skills.description: Build forms with clear validation, accessible errors, loading and disabled states, and protection against duplicate submission.

skills.name: Animation and Interaction
skills.description: Add purposeful transitions and feedback while respecting reduced-motion preferences and avoiding distraction.

skills.name: API Design
skills.description: Design HTTP APIs with clear semantics, correct status codes, validation, pagination, and consistent error shapes.

skills.name: Database Design
skills.description: Choose data types, keys, indexes, and transaction boundaries deliberately, and keep migrations safe.

skills.name: Authentication and Authorization
skills.description: Separate authentication from authorization, enforce least privilege and ownership checks, and handle sessions and tokens safely.

skills.name: Secure Backend
skills.description: Validate input, encode output, prevent injection, limit rates, and handle secrets, uploads, and errors safely.

skills.name: Backend Architecture
skills.description: Place domain logic, boundaries, configuration, and error handling sensibly without over-engineering small applications.

skills.name: Integration Engineering
skills.description: Call external services reliably with timeouts, retries, backoff, idempotency, and webhook verification.

skills.name: Backend Performance
skills.description: Find and fix slow queries, N+1 patterns, missing caching, and connection or job bottlenecks using measurements.

skills.name: Data Validation and Integrity
skills.description: Validate at trust boundaries, distinguish syntactic from business-rule checks, and keep updates transactional.

skills.name: UI/UX Design
skills.description: Design complete flows with clear hierarchy and explicit empty, loading, error, success, and disabled states.

skills.name: Anti-Generic UI
skills.description: Avoid templated, decorative UI when the brief calls for something specific; choose layout, type, and color deliberately.

skills.name: Design From Reference
skills.description: Analyze reference designs and reproduce relevant structure and style without overclaiming fidelity or infringing rights.

skills.name: Microinteractions
skills.description: Design hover, focus, loading, transition, and feedback behavior that stays keyboard-friendly and reduced-motion aware.

skills.name: SVG Craft
skills.description: Construct SVG deliberately: correct viewBox, intentional geometry, consistent strokes, and no pointless decoration.

skills.name: Custom Illustration
skills.description: Plan an illustration from a design brief covering subject, meaning, composition, palette, and detail level.

skills.name: Icon Design
skills.description: Design icons on a consistent grid with readable silhouettes, coherent corners, and no detail that disappears at small sizes.

skills.name: Logo Mark Design
skills.description: Design marks that read at small sizes, work in monochrome, and use negative space deliberately. No trademark claims.

skills.name: SVG Optimization
skills.description: Reduce SVG size and noise without destroying semantics, accessibility, or intended rendering.

skills.name: SVG Accessibility
skills.description: Give meaningful SVGs accessible names with title and desc, and hide decorative ones from assistive technology.

skills.name: SVG Security
skills.description: Treat SVG as potentially active content: reject scripts, event handlers, unsafe references, and untrusted foreignObject.

skills.name: SVG Visual Review
skills.description: Review SVG output against a structured checklist: composition, balance, spacing, contrast, and fidelity to the brief.

skills.name: Unit Testing
skills.description: Test meaningful behavior and edge cases in the project's existing framework, without brittle or truth-hiding tests.

skills.name: Integration Testing
skills.description: Test real boundaries: databases, HTTP APIs, authentication flows, and third-party failures.

skills.name: End-to-End Testing
skills.description: Cover critical user journeys with end-to-end tests that survive refactors and catch regressions.

skills.name: Debugging and Root Cause Analysis
skills.description: Reproduce, gather evidence, form a hypothesis, apply a minimal fix, add a regression test, and verify.

skills.name: Regression Review
skills.description: Check a change for unintended effects on existing behavior before declaring it done.

skills.name: Secure Coding
skills.description: Apply defensive coding habits: validate untrusted input, encode output, avoid injection, and fail safely.

skills.name: OWASP-Oriented Web Security Review
skills.description: Review code against recognized web application risk categories and state clearly which checks were not performed.

skills.name: Dependency Auditing
skills.description: Check dependencies for known advisories, unused packages, and unnecessary transitive surface.

skills.name: Secret Management
skills.description: Keep credentials out of code, logs, fixtures, and docs, and load them from the environment or a secret store.

skills.name: Authorization Review
skills.description: Verify that every protected action enforces ownership and role server-side, not just in the client.

skills.name: Threat Modeling
skills.description: Identify assets, trust boundaries, entry points, and realistic threats before building a feature.

skills.name: Secure File Handling
skills.description: Handle uploads, paths, and archives safely against traversal, type confusion, and resource exhaustion.

skills.name: Safe Error Handling
skills.description: Return useful errors to users and logs without leaking stack traces, queries, or internal identifiers.

skills.name: Git Workflow
skills.description: Make focused commits and branches with clear messages, without rewriting shared history.

skills.name: Pull Request Review
skills.description: Review changes for correctness, scope, tests, and risk, and give specific, actionable feedback.

skills.name: Docker and Containers
skills.description: Write small, reproducible, non-root container builds with sane layers, health checks, and secret handling.

skills.name: CI/CD
skills.description: Build pipelines that are fast, least-privilege, pinned, and that fail loudly on real problems.

skills.name: Environment Configuration
skills.description: Separate configuration from code, document required variables, and validate configuration at startup.

skills.name: Deployment Readiness
skills.description: Confirm the release is actually ready: migrations, rollback, config, observability, and a documented runbook.

skills.name: Logging and Observability
skills.description: Emit structured logs, useful metrics, and traces without logging secrets or personal data.

skills.name: Database Migration Review
skills.description: Review schema migrations for lock risk, backward compatibility, data backfill, and rollback.

skills.name: Dependency Management
skills.description: Add dependencies only when justified, keep lockfiles committed, and update deliberately.

skills.name: Release Notes
skills.description: Write release notes that describe real user-visible changes, breaking changes, and migration steps.

skills.name: Task Planning
skills.description: Turn a complex requirement into small, ordered, independently testable steps before writing code.

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Review correctness, security, maintainability, and scope before proposing or approving changes.

skills.name: Technical Documentation
skills.description: Keep documentation consistent with verified code behavior, and never document features that do not exist.

skills.name: Anti-Slop Review
skills.description: Detect preventable quality problems such as dead code, fake tests, placeholder features, and needless abstraction.
